//: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored and must never be committed — it holds the SQL password and the agent key.

sql.//: Use EITHER port (recommended, needs a static port) OR instanceName (needs SQL Server Browser running).

query.//: Which table holds the punches, and what its columns are called. Run `npm run discover` to list them.
query.//cursorMode: 'id' walks an always-increasing key and never misses a row. 'time' is the fallback when the table has no such column.

sync.//: How often to look for new punches, in seconds.
sync.//backfillDays: How many past days to confirm on startup, so days missed while this PC was off get closed.
